***I am not speaking on behalf of WotC's legal department
***The following are just some common-sense observations

The use of WotC's icons, card layout, and name is protected by
copyright, which you have probably violated. In addition, you have
identified the artwork as being owned by WotC, when it is actually
owned by (I guess) West End games, so I suspect you may have violated
several copyright laws by that misrepresentation.

For more information on what you are allowed to do under
copyright law, see WotC's legal corner web page:

http://www.wizards.com/About_Wizards/Legal/

Or send mail to them at le...@wizards.com

In general, you would want to check about copyright considerations
*before* you post something of that nature.

--
